purpose: Test whether the failed J1A self-consistency metric was caused by finite-difference noise from the h->S->u roundtrip rather than by the closed-form derivative of the frozen C1R table law.

frozen_candidate.representation: C1R N241 float32 bilinear log-mobility table in u=log10(-h)

finite_difference_precommit.cell_boundary_cap: 0.05 times distance to nearest table-cell boundary
finite_difference_precommit.explicit_rule: These are exactly the original J1A perturbations. No perturbation-size tuning is permitted in R1.

oracle_repair.independent_flux_evaluator: Re-evaluate the frozen C1R bilinear table law directly from perturbed head coordinates. Do not call the analytic derivative routine and do not route the FD perturbation through s_of_h followed by state_to_u.
oracle_repair.reason: The derivative under test is dq/dh of the head-parameterized frozen face law. The original J1A FD path inserted an analytically cancelling h->S->u roundtrip whose floating-point error is divided by a very small FD step and can dominate near a zero endpoint derivative.
oracle_repair.base_equivalence_check: At every unperturbed probe, direct-head flux must match the production C1R state-based lookup to <=1e-12 scaled error.

diagnostics: record original state-roundtrip FD metric beside repaired head-coordinate FD metric
record which endpoint and derivative magnitude controls any failure

exit_rule.pass: Classify original J1A failure as finite-difference oracle roundoff amplification, qualify the real C1R face derivative on strict table-cell interiors, and permit J1B same-factorization whole-column tangent work.
exit_rule.fail: Keep J1B closed and classify the remaining cause as derivative representation/discrete algebra/interpolation semantics rather than oracle roundoff alone.

scope_guards: No saturation, heterogeneous, groundwater or MODFLOW claim.
